|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “May deploy - 1 as a 'react' to a site where you have a Rebel. When deployed, you may 'peek' at the top card of any Reserve Deck, and may place that card on the bottom of that Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May deploy -1 as a ‘react’ to same site as a Rebel. When deployed, may peek at the top card of a Reserve Deck; may place that card on bottom of that Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' “- 1” → “-1”; “'react'” → “‘react’”; “a” → “same”; “where you have” → “as”; removed “you”; “'peek'” → “peek”; “any” → “a”; “Deck, and” → “Deck;”; removed “the”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 16. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
